settings.subheading: NYT Best Selling Author of Metabolic Freedom

"Most saunas just make you sweat—SaunaSpace helps you heal. It combines near-infrared light therapy with zero EMF, zero flicker technology to deliver deep cellular repair without the hidden stressors found in typical infrared units.

I love that it’s made with non-toxic materials like organic cotton and sustainable wood, and the fact that it’s portable means I can take my healing sanctuary anywhere. This isn’t just about sweating—it’s about mitochondrial repair, circadian rhythm optimization, and activating the body’s innate intelligence to detox, heal, and thrive."

The warmth it provides is incredibly soothing and makes each session so relaxing. Plus, it has zero EMF, giving me peace of mind about limiting my exposure to EMFs, unlike other brands.

I also use it over my thyroid for just 10 minutes every day, and I feel a surge of energy comparable to having a strong cup of coffee. SaunaSpace has truly been a game-changer for my wellness routine!"

In this demanding world of ‘eat this, not that,’ SaunaSpace invites us into its sacred, protected space, where—through the healing powers of red light and heat—all we are asked to do is just sit and breathe. We need more of that in our lives."

settings.heading: Our Founder's Story
settings.content: After reversing his own chronic symptoms using near infrared sauna therapy, Brian Richards founded SaunaSpace to unite time-tested healing practices with the science of red light and cellular renewal, making powerful, natural wellness accessible at home in a truly portable infrared sauna.

settings.title: Build a Better Sauna? We've Done It.
settings.content: With over ten years of R&D at the forefront of biophysics, we’ve fused the best of both worlds, red light therapy and incandescent near infrared sauna heat, into one revolutionary system. We’re on a different wavelength. Literally.

settings.subtitle: THE SILVER STANDARD IN EMF DEFENSE
settings.title: Discover True EMF Protection
settings.content: Most saunas emit EMFs from their own components, adding stress to what should be a healing space. SaunaSpace® is different. Each sauna is grounded and shielded to block internal EMFs, creating a truly low EMF experience. For the ultimate sanctuary, shielded from ambient signals like Wi-Fi and cell towers, add the SilverLining™ Upgrade and retreat into an oasis of deep restoration and stillness.

settings.name: Ana Carolina W.
settings.title: Excellent to have in health toolkit.
settings.content: "I have loved my Glow red light!!! It has been highly beneficial in my life. In the mornings, I get a burst of energy after doing targeted therapy on my face and neck region. It has helped me at night to wind down and support my natural circadian rhythm. I am now working on helping my scalp to help lessen some slight hair loss and support my ovaries. It has so many ways to impact your health! I highly recommend! ❤️"

settings.name: Hilary
settings.title: I love this sauna so much!
settings.content:
"This review is long overdue, but I just had to post because I had an incredible experience recently. I’ve been using my sauna regularly for the past 3 1/2 years, and it has helped me in so many ways — high energy levels, great mood, high-quality sleep, glowy skin, fast recovery from workouts. But the most amazing thing happened last week, I went to the functional medicine doctor for the first time in years, just to check up on everything, and they did a full panel of bloodwork, they must’ve taken like 30 vials of blood and tested for everything — from nutrition and hormones to inflammatory markers and even toxins like heavy metals and mold.

When I went for the follow up appointment, my doctor seemed stunned. He said that in 15 years of practicing functional medicine, he had never seen bloodwork like mine. He said I was biologically decades younger than my chronological age, and asked what I had been doing lifestyle-wise.

There wasn’t much to talk about during my appointment, so I told him all about my sauna :-) thank you thank you thank you, SaunaSpace for this amazing gift of health."
